g.text: THM-GG-KMPT-RHO-OPTIMAL\nKMPT: rho collides in Theta(sqrt|G|), constant <= 52.5\nE[T_collision] <= (1+o(1)) 12 sqrt(19) sqrt|G| < 52.5 sqrt|G|

g.text: THM-XT-MASSER-DEPENDENCE\nMasser: dependent specializations have density zero

g.text: THM-XT-TRACE-MAP-DISTORTION\nThe trace map distorts some points but not the G1/G2 eigenspaces
